purpose: Composite evidence-chain closure gate for C01. It validates that the reviewed production artifact bundle, production verifier-adapter acceptance, SBF/live lineage acceptance, and audit/reviewer acceptance packets all describe the same selected backend, proof tuple, source-review acceptance, deterministic build/output-manifest prerequisites, current source ACIR, current H6 public input binding and adapter public-input binding flag, production verifying-key hash, adapter boundary, mutation/no-mutation refs, lineage ref, and audit acceptance ref.

validates: same selected backend and route across all reviewed packets
source-review acceptance and deterministic build/output-manifest prerequisite refs are present in the reviewed production bundle
same current source ACIR hash and selected tag-3 Groth16 proof tuple
adapter public-input label/value/commitment and production binding flag match the production bundle
same production verifying-key artifact and production verifying-key hash
same accepted verifier adapter or verifier program boundary
same valid mutation and invalid/wrong-input/wrong-key no-mutation refs
externalClosureValidation.truthBoundary: This makes C01 verifier evidence-chain validation executable but does not supply any reviewed evidence. Without all four env vars, the closure gate remains blocked with accepted refs null.

crossPacketInvariants: production bundle, adapter acceptance, SBF/live lineage acceptance, and audit/reviewer acceptance must all use selectedBackend groth16-tag3-solana-v0
all reviewed packets must share routeId sunspot-noir-acir-gnark-groth16-solana-v0

closure must reject a production bundle that sets positive flags without non-empty source-review acceptance, trusted setup or mitigation, output-manifest, reproducibility, and deterministic build refs
production proof-format refs must target solana-c01-tag3-groth16-v0 and gnark-solana-native-proof-and-public-witness-v0
public witness binding must match the current H6 private-spend public input value and commitment
adapter public-input binding must use the same label, value, commitment, and positive production-binding flag as the production bundle
production verifying-key hash must match across artifact bundle, adapter acceptance, lineage acceptance, and audit acceptance
adapter acceptance refs and mutation/no-mutation refs must match across production bundle, adapter acceptance, and audit acceptance
SBF/live lineage ref must match across production bundle, adapter acceptance downstream refs, lineage acceptance, and audit acceptance
audit/reviewer acceptance ref must match across production bundle, adapter acceptance downstream refs, and audit acceptance
remainingBlockers: no reviewed deterministic production artifact build/output-manifest prerequisite refs
no complete cross-packet C01 verifier evidence-chain validation
truthBoundary: This is a blocked C01 verifier evidence-chain closure gate. It defines refs-only cross-packet validation for the selected backend, but it is not production proof-format evidence, not production verifying-key evidence, not verifier-adapter acceptance, not valid mutation evidence, not invalid/wrong-input/wrong-key no-mutation evidence, not SBF/live lineage, not audit/reviewer acceptance, not C01 closure, and not production-private readiness.
